mapper.select: select nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) from tb_warehouse_stock s join tb_goods g on s.goods_no = g.goods_no where g.use_yn = 'Y'

select w.warehouse_name as label, nvl(sum(case when g.use_yn = 'Y' then s.stock_qty end), 0) as value from tb_warehouse w left join tb_warehouse_stock s on w.warehouse_no = s.warehouse_no left join tb_goods g on s.goods_no = g.goods_no where w.use_yn = 'Y' group by w.warehouse_no, w.warehouse_name order by w.warehouse_no

select c.category_name as label, nvl(sum(s.stock_qty), 0) as value from tb_category c left join tb_goods g on c.category_no = g.category_no and g.use_yn = 'Y' left join tb_warehouse_stock s on g.goods_no = s.goods_no where c.use_yn = 'Y' group by c.category_no, c.category_name order by c.category_no
